title: Lesson 03: Clean Your Lens
sources: Samsung and Apple support: clean camera lenses with a soft, lint-free microfiber cloth

lines.text: Your fingers touch it all day, and leave grease behind,
and pockets and bags add dust and lint.
That film makes lights glow and details blur.
Wipe it gently with a soft microfiber cloth,
not your shirt, which can rub grit into the glass.
Make it a habit: one quick wipe before every shot.
lines.caps: MAKE IT A *HABIT | ONE QUICK *WIPE | EVERY *SHOT
